4uxfd1m72vjbwSELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT C.* FROM ( SELECT A.ACMASTCODE, SUM(NVL(B.AMOUNT, :"SYS_B_00")) AS AMOUNT, MAX(NVL(B.BALANCE, :"SYS_B_01")) AS BALANCE, MAX(NVL(B.CSHDEBITAMT, :"SYS_B_02")) AS CSHDEBITAMT, MAX(NVL(B.CSHCREDITAMT, :"SYS_B_03")) AS CSHCREDITAMT, MAX(NVL(B.TRFDEBITAMT, :"SYS_B_04")) TRFDEBITAMT, MAX(NVL(B.TRFCREDITAMT, :"SYS_B_05")) AS TRFCREDITAMT, MAX(NVL(B.DEBITAMT, :"SYS_B_06")) AS DEBITAMT, MAX(NVL(B.CREDITAMT, :"SYS_B_07")) AS CREDITAMT, MAX(NVL(B.INTAMT, :"SYS_B_08")) AS INTAMT, MAX(NVL(B.COMMAMT, :"SYS_B_09")) AS COMMAMT, MAX(NVL(B.CHRGAMT, :"SYS_B_10")) AS CHRGAMT, MAX(NVL(B.RBTAMT, :"SYS_B_11")) RBTAMT, SUM(CASE WHEN A.AC_TYPE = B.AC_TYPE THEN :"SYS_B_12" ELSE :"SYS_B_13" END) HOVRFYRQ, SUM(CASE WHEN TRIM(A.AC_STAT) = TRIM(B.AC_STAT) THEN :"SYS_B_14" ELSE :"SYS_B_15" END) HOVRFYRQ1, SUM(CASE WHEN TRIM(A.GL_STAT) = TRIM(B.GL_STAT) THEN :"SYS_B_16" ELSE :"SYS_B_17" END ) HOVRFYRQ2, SUM(CASE WHEN A.ACMASTCODE = B.ACMASTCODE THEN :"SYS_B_18" ELSE :"SYS_B_19" END) HOVRFYRQ3 , B.HOVRFYSETUPSRNO FROM ACMAST A, HOVRFYSETUP B, HOVRFYPROC C WHERE :"SYS_B_20"=:"SYS_B_21" AND B.HOVYFYPROCSRNO=C.HOVRFYPROCSRNO AND B.HOVYFYPROCSRNO=:"SYS_B_22" AND (NVL(B.ACMASTCODE, :"SYS_B_23")>:"SYS_B_24" OR NVL(B.AC_TYPE, :"SYS_B_25")>:"SYS_B_26" OR TRIM(B.AC_STAT) IS NOT NULL OR TRIM(B.GL_STAT) IS NOT NULL ) AND (CASE WHEN NVL(B.ACMASTCODE, :"SYS_B_27")>:"SYS_B_28" AND A.ACMASTCODE=B.ACMASTCODE THEN :"SYS_B_29" WHEN NVL(B.AC_TYPE, :"SYS_B_30")>:"SYS_B_31" AND A.AC_TYPE=B.AC_TYPE THEN :"SYS_B_32" WHEN TRIM(B.AC_STAT) IS NOT NULL AND A.AC_STAT=B.AC_STAT THEN :"SYS_B_33" WHEN TRIM(B.GL_STAT) IS NOT NULL AND A.GL_STAT=B.GL_STAT THEN :"SYS_B_34" ELSE :"SYS_B_35" END )=:"SYS_B_36" GROUP BY A.ACMASTCODE, B.HOVRFYSETUPSRNO ) C WHERE HOVRFYRQ+HOVRFYRQ1+HOVRFYRQ2+HOVRFYRQ3>:"SYS_B_37" )

:"SYS_B_15")<>:"SYS_B_16" AND (NVL(A.INCOME_SCH, :"SYS_B_17") <> :"SYS_B_18" ) AND A.BRANCHCODE = :"SYS_B_19" ) SELECT A.ACMASTCODE, A.AC_NO, A.NAME, A.IX_ACCD, A.IX_ACNO, A.IX_ACMASTCODE, A.AC_CODE, A.IX_ACMASTCODE, A.AC_CODE, A.AC_NAME, A.MAC_NAME, A.AC_TYPE, A.GLNAME, A.MGLNAME, A.ACTYPE FROM TABMISTRFAC A WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT :"SYS_B_24" FROM FDMAS B WHERE A.IX_ACMASTCODE=B.ACMASTCODE AND A.ACTYPE FROM TABMISTRFAC A WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT :"SYS_B_26" FROM CURMAS B WHERE A.IX_ACMASTCODE=B.ACMASTCODE AND A.IX_ACNO=B.AC_NO) AND ACTYPE=:"SYS_B_27" UNION ALL SELECT A.ACMASTCODE, A.AC_NO, A.NAME, A.IX_ACCD, A.IX_ACNO, A.IX_ACMASTCODE, A.AC_CODE, A.AC_NAME, A.MAC_NAME, A.AC_TYPE, A.GLNAME, A.MGLNAME, A.ACTYPE FROM TABMISTRFAC A WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT :"SYS_B_28" FROM SSDMAS B WHERE A.IX_ACMASTCODE=B.ACMASTCODE AND A.IX_ACNO=B.AC_NO) AND ACTYPE=:"SYS_B_29") A UNION ALL SELECT A.ACMASTCODE, A.AC_NO, D.NAME, IX_ACCD, IX_ACNO, :"SYS_B_30" IX_ACMASTCODE, C.AC_CODE, C.AC_NAME, C.MAC_NAME, C.AC_TYPE , RPAD(:"SYS_B_31", :"SYS_B_32", :"SYS_B_33") AS GLNAME, RPAD(:"SYS_B_34", :"SYS_B_35", :"SYS_B_36") AS MGLNAME FROM FDMAS A, BANKMAS D, ACMAST C WHERE (IX_ACCD IS NULL AND IX_ACNO IS NULL) AND NVL(C.MISITRFACMCD, :"SYS_B_37")=:"SYS_B_38" AND A.GMST_CODE=D.GMST_CODE AND NVL(A.CLOSED, :"SYS_B_39")<>:"SYS_B_40" AND A.ACMASTCODE=C.ACMASTCODE AND A.BRANCHCODE = :"SYS_B_41" AND (NVL(A.INCOME_SCH, :"SYS_B_42") <> :"SYS_B_43" )) ORDER BY ACMASTCODE, AC_NO)

Finding 1: Session Connect and Disconnect
Impact is 1.55 active sessions, 18.41% of total activity.
---------------------------------------------------------
Session connect and disconnect calls were consuming significant database time.

   --------------------------------------------------------------------
   Action
      Investigate application logic for possible reduction of connect and
      disconnect calls. For example, you might use a connection pool scheme in
      the middle tier.

Finding 3: Soft Parse
Impact is .62 active sessions, 7.75% of total activity.
-------------------------------------------------------
Soft parsing of SQL statements was consuming significant database time.

   Recommendation 1: Application Analysis
   Estimated benefit is .62 active sessions, 7.75% of total activity.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------
   Action
      Investigate application logic to keep open the frequently used cursors.
      Note that cursors are closed by both cursor close calls and session
      disconnects.

   Recommendation 2: Database Configuration
   Estimated benefit is .62 active sessions, 7.75% of total activity.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------
   Action
      Consider increasing the session cursor cache size by increasing the
      value of parameter "session_cached_cursors".
   Rationale
      The value of parameter "session_cached_cursors" was "300" during the
      analysis period.
